zh: 合法分组的所有成员都含有同一个数字 d，所以分组大小不会超过“含有 d 的元素个数”；反过来，所有含 d 的元素一定能组成合法分组。
因此只要对数字 0..9 分别统计有多少个元素包含它，取最大值即可。注意同一个元素的十位和个位相同时只能算一次。
开长度为 10 的计数数组；对每个两位数取十位 t 和个位 o：counts[t] 加一，若 o≠t 再给 counts[o] 加一；输出计数数组的最大值。
en: All members of a valid group share some digit d, so the group cannot be larger than the number of elements containing d; conversely, all elements containing d always form a valid group.
So count, for each digit 0..9, how many elements contain it, and take the maximum. When an element's tens and units digits are equal, it must be counted only once.
Use a counting array of size 10; for each two-digit number take its tens digit t and units digit o: add one to counts[t], and add one to counts[o] only if o != t; print the maximum of the array.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Count, for each digit 0..9, how many array elements contain it. For a number, add one for its tens digit first, and add one for its units digit only when it differs from the tens digit. The largest count is the answer.

## Why it is correct

Any valid group must have a digit d shared by all its members, so its size does not exceed the number of elements containing d. Conversely, all the elements containing d always form a valid group, so the maximum of the ten counts is both an upper bound and an achievable solution.

## Complexity

Time O(n), extra space O(1) apart from the input.
